facts.text: John expressed gratitude towards Maria for her support, stating that her words give him motivation to keep going despite the challenges he faces.

evidence.quote: Maria, your support really means a lot! It's tough, but your kind words give me the motivation to keep going.
Your words really mean something. Sometimes it feels like it's too much, but your encouragement gives me the strength to keep going.

facts.text: Maria affirmed her belief in John, encouraging him to take small steps and stay true to himself as he continues his efforts.

evidence.quote: John, I believe in you! Even small steps will make a difference. Keep going and stay true to yourself.

facts.text: Maria reassured John that it is okay to feel overwhelmed and advised him to pause, reflect, and take care of himself.

evidence.quote: Hey John, it's okay to feel overwhelmed from time to time. Just remember to pause, reflect, and take care of yourself.

facts.text: John mentioned that he decided to run for office again, despite not having been successful before, and expressed his determination to make a difference in his community.

evidence.quote: Last week, I decided to run for office again - even though I haven't been successful before. I guess I can't let go of my dream to make a difference in my community.
